pool.text: roll_diceRoll dice using standard notation (e.g. 2d6, 1d20+5). Used for RPG mechanics, skill checks, and random outcomes.▼
update_game_stateUpdate the current game state — character stats, inventory, quest progress, etc.▼
set_expressionSet a character's sprite expression for visual novel display.▼
trigger_eventTrigger a narrative event — introduce an NPC, start a quest, change the scene, etc.▼
search_lorebookSearch the lorebook for relevant world-building information.▼
read_chat_summaryRead the current persisted chat summary for this chat.▼
append_chat_summaryAppend durable memory text to the persisted chat summary for this chat.▼
read_chat_variableRead a chat-wide string variable by key. Use this for agent-private state or coordination with other agents in the same chat.▼
write_chat_variableWrite or replace a chat-wide string variable by key. Any agent in this chat can read the value if it knows the key.▼
music_get_current_playbackGet the current De-Koi Music Player playback state for this chat.▼
music_resolve_candidatesResolve YouTube music candidates for a roleplay or conversation scene. Use this before music_play.▼
music_playStart Music Player playback with a resolved YouTube track.▼
music_set_volumeSet De-Koi Music Player volume from 0 to 100.▼
music_feedbackRecord Music Player feedback such as play, skip, like, or dislike for future ranking.▼
lookup_pricecustomLooks up an item price.▼
post_notecustom▼
no_params_hookcustomWebhook with no properties key▼

pool: A short summary of what this agent does. Shown in the agents panel to help you identify each agent.
Who authored or maintains this agent.
Globally enables or disables this agent. Disabled agents stay configured but do not run.
When this agent runs during generation. Pre-Generation runs before the AI replies, Parallel runs alongside, Post-Processing runs after the reply is complete.
Controls how De-Koi interprets this custom agent's output. Use Text Rewrite for post-processing agents that edit the generated reply.
Optional current-turn data for custom post-processing agents. Existing agents stay isolated unless these are enabled.
Allows this custom agent to create or update entries in one selected lorebook.
Use a different AI connection for this agent. For example, use a faster/cheaper model for background processing tasks.
Controls how much recent chat context the agent reads and how much output room it reserves. If max output is too high for the model context, prompt context can be trimmed.
How many user messages should pass since this custom agent last ran before it triggers again. Set to 1 to run whenever its phase runs.
When keywords are set, this custom agent is skipped unless at least one keyword appears in the recent chat messages it scans.
When enabled, this agent's output becomes available as a marker section in prompt presets. Add the section in your preset to inject the agent's latest data into the prompt.
The system instructions this agent receives. Built-in agents have sensible defaults. You can override to customize behavior.
Select which tools this agent can use during generation. The AI can call these functions and receive results back for multi-step interactions.

pool: A short summary of what this agent does. Shown in the agents panel to help you identify each agent.
Who authored or maintains this agent.
Globally enables or disables this agent. Disabled agents stay configured but do not run.
When this agent runs during generation. Pre-Generation runs before the AI replies, Parallel runs alongside, Post-Processing runs after the reply is complete.
Controls how De-Koi interprets this custom agent's output. Use Text Rewrite for post-processing agents that edit the generated reply.
Allows this custom agent to create or update entries in one selected lorebook.
Use a different AI connection for this agent. For example, use a faster/cheaper model for background processing tasks.
Controls how much recent chat context the agent reads and how much output room it reserves. If max output is too high for the model context, prompt context can be trimmed.
How many user messages should pass since this custom agent last ran before it triggers again. Set to 1 to run whenever its phase runs.
When keywords are set, this custom agent is skipped unless at least one keyword appears in the recent chat messages it scans.
When enabled, this agent's output becomes available as a marker section in prompt presets. Add the section in your preset to inject the agent's latest data into the prompt.
The system instructions this agent receives. Built-in agents have sensible defaults. You can override to customize behavior.
Select which tools this agent can use during generation. The AI can call these functions and receive results back for multi-step interactions.

The system instructions this agent receives. Built-in agents have sensible defaults. You can override to customize behavior.
Select which tools this agent can use during generation. The AI can call these functions and receive results back for multi-step interactions.

Describe the environment and atmosphere with enough detail that an artist could paint it. 9.
